title: Congratulations Nico!
text: Congratulations to Nicolás Sánchez-Fuenzalida for successfully defending his PhD thesis on perceptual versus response biases in conscious perception!

title: Congratulations Lola!
text: Congratulations to Lola Beerendonk on her outstanding work and presentation of neural correlates of conscious perception!

title: Congratulations Samuel!
text: Congratulations to Samuel Noorman for his publications and groundbreaking findings on predictive sensory mechanisms!

title: Congratulations Stijn!
text: Congratulations to Stijn Nuiten for his successful PhD thesis defense on baseline neural states and visual awareness!

title: Johannes Receives Faculty's Open Science Award
text: Johannes Fahrenfort was awarded the Faculty Open Science Award for developing and sharing the ADAM decoding toolbox for EEG and MEG research.

title: Simon Interviewed for Dutch National Newspaper
text: Simon van Gaal was interviewed by major national Dutch media discussing how neuroscience investigates consciousness, free will, and unconscious processing.

title: Johannes Interviewed for Kids TV (Proefkonijnen)
text: Johannes Fahrenfort was interviewed for the popular Dutch television program 'Proefkonijnen' (BNNVARA / NPO 3) testing how our brains process sensory stimuli and conscious awareness.

title: Two PNAS Publications in One Year!
text: Exciting scientific milestone: lab members published two major papers in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS) uncovering neural signatures of perceptual consciousness.

title: Simon Receives ERC Consolidator Grant
text: Simon van Gaal has been awarded a prestigious European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant of €2 million to investigate the neural mechanisms of conscious experience and cognitive control.

title: Johannes Receives Templeton ARC Grant
text: Johannes Fahrenfort has been awarded a grant from the Templeton World Charity Foundation (Accelerating Research on Consciousness) to test adversarial predictions between theories of consciousness.

title: Conscious Brain Lab Organizes ASSC 25
text: Our lab co-organized the 25th Annual Meeting of the Association for the Scientific Study of Consciousness (ASSC) held in Amsterdam, welcoming over 500 consciousness researchers from across the globe.

title: Congratulations Valeria!
text: Valeria Mongelli completed her postdoctoral project on unconscious semantic processing and language integration.

title: ABC Grant for Maartje de Jong: New CBL Member!
text: Dr. Maartje de Jong received an Amsterdam Brain and Cognition (ABC) talent grant to join the Conscious Brain Lab studying bistable visual perception.

title: Congratulations to Erik!
text: Erik Meijs published key findings on visual awareness and feedback processing before moving to his next appointment.

title: Congratulations to Camile!
text: Camile Correa completed her research project in the lab on psychophysical methods in visual awareness.

title: ASSC 20 in Krakow!
text: Conscious Brain Lab members gave symposia and posters at ASSC 20 in Krakow, Poland.

title: Congratulations Josipa!
text: Josipa Alilović presented her neural oscillation findings at international conferences.
